engine_models: resolved_pump_composite@1 over resolved_pump_tissue@3 (the species-only world of the secreted-species fixtures: ions at the bath's composition with zero permeability)
cells.passive_routes@1 with passive_neutral_permeation@1: miR200 alone on each junction, P A = G (no routes at D = 0)

model.units: scaled units: one unit is 1 uM in the engine's world; time in s (BITSEY's unit)
equations: du/dt = g_u H(z; K_u, n_u, lambda_u) - k_u u + (junction terms, u only)
dm/dt = g_m H(z; K_m, n_m, lambda_m) - k_m m
dz/dt = g_z m sum_{i=0..6} C(6, i) l_i X^i / (1 + X)^6 - k_z z, X = u / x0
junction (a, b): its flux G (u_a - u_b) leaves a and enters b; G / V = D A_cell / (L_GJ V_cell) = 3 D / (r L_GJ)
model.constants_source: BITSEY's cancer_GJ_sims/GRN_miRNA.py at b2cb370 (numbers only, D208), scaled as it scales them, with Snail = 72 folded into g_u = 6 (1 + 0.4)/2 and g_m = (5/12)(1 + 10)/2; ITERATE = False, so the binding uses total miR200

seeds.note: BITSEY seeds 0 where these are 1e-6 (the engine needs positive amounts)

stages.rule: stage 1: one tumor cell and one healthy cell, no junctions, 500 s from the seeds, once; every tumor cell of stage 2 starts at stage 1's tumor end state, every healthy cell at its healthy one; stage 2 runs 20,000 s coupled, its clock from 0

criterion.cell: u > m + 2 at the end of stage 2, in every cell
criterion.rows: for every row, max m - min m <= 2; a row is the cells with one z (the last lattice index)
criterion.source: BITSEY's GRN_miRNA.py healthy_snapped_rows (line 519), on the whole field

line.lattice: 1 x 1 x 25: cells c0..c24 along z
line.rows: each cell is its own row, so the spread condition is empty

field.lattice: 1 x 25 x 25: cell c{y}_{z}, y and z in 0..24
field.tumor: y < 6 and z < 6 (a 6 x 6 block at the corner)
field.junctions: one per pair one lattice step apart (c{y}_{z} - c{y}_{z+1} and c{y}_{z} - c{y+1}_{z}), 1,200 in all; no diagonals

search.ends: D = 0 must not normalize and D = 1e-13 must; both are run
search.stop: hi <= (1 + 0.001) lo, hi the smallest normalizing D and lo the largest below it that does not; reported x2 = hi
search.placement: one point per CPU; the first points are the bracket's ends and dyadic points 1e-13/2^k, k from 1 on the line and from 4 on the field (the largest that runs at the base step, neither.first_points); then each finished worker takes a new point inside the current bracket (neither.place)
search.step: per point, dt = 1/8 s halved until dt x 2 x neighbours x G/V <= 0.04 (neither.step); stage 1 at the shape's finest coupled step (1/64 s on the line, 1/128 s on the field)
search.convergence: the final bracket's two ends rerun at half their step (C)
search.retry: if C fails, the whole search once more at half the step rule, with its own C at a quarter; if that C fails too, the geometry is inconclusive. A run the harness stops is rerun once from the same snapshot; an engine refusal is a result. neither.py's search has no step option yet: a retry needs a tagged amendment adding it before it runs (D308)

verdicts.R: refinement: converged, no refused point, monotone, both ends as required
verdicts.C: the final bracket's ends keep their outcomes at half their step
verdicts.A: Cells' [lo - w/3, hi + w/3] overlaps the reference's bracket (verified at a ten-fold tighter tolerance)
verdicts.geometry: failed if a point is refused, a bracket end is wrong, or A fails with R and C passed; inconclusive if the outcomes are not monotone or C fails after its retry; else passed
verdicts.overall: any failed geometry makes it failed; else any inconclusive makes it inconclusive; else any not assessable makes it not assessable; else passed (D308)

plants.what: a reference bracket 1% above Cells' interval
a reference bracket inside Cells' widened interval but outside its bracket
plants.expected: A passes: the margin is the stated w/3

plants.what: a refused point in Cells' search
a half-step rerun that flips an outcome
a reference whose bracket ends flip at the tighter tolerance
a reference echoing a different constant (Snail's g_u 4.0)

reported.bitsey: the historical logs and the pinned run, each bracket at full precision, its overlap with Cells' interval, the ratio hi_Cells / hi_BITSEY and the outcomes at common points; never judged

line.revision: earlier than b2cb370: its search is titled 'lowest Kd that fixes a 1-spot', which no committed revision from 04225e4 (20 May 2026) on prints; its result line 'Final NR=0' is 04225e4's format, not b2cb370's

field.revision: earlier than b2cb370: its result line 'Final NR=0: ...' is 04225e4's format (20 May 2026); b2cb370 prints '0. Final underexp=0.3: ...'. GRN_miRNA.py and sim.py differ between 04225e4 and b2cb370 in comments and one equivalent expression only; zombie.py's protocol code changed

pinned_run.field: zombie_tumor_isolate 1 25 25 0 0 1, stopped once the first search has printed its result
pinned_run.licence: none at b2cb370 or at the newest head (7e4fb45d, 22 November 2026); seven tracked files point to a LICENSE that does not exist; the user's D208 was ruled knowing this

keys.model: {constants: {every key of model.constants, each value as read}, seeds: {tumor: {u, m, z}, healthy: {u, m, z}} as read from model.seeds}
keys.stage1: {tumor: {u, m, z}, healthy: {u, m, z}} after 500 s uncoupled
keys.geometries: {line, field}: {bracket: [lo, hi], points: [{d, normalized, epithelial_cells, min_margin, max_row_spread}], tighter: {factor, lo_normalized, hi_normalized}, method}; a geometry the references did not compute is absent and is then not assessable

conditions: lo not normalized and hi normalized, in points and again at the tighter tolerance
points monotone in d, with 0 not normalized and 1e-13 normalized

not_blind.line: Not blind (D219): the registrant's development search neither-02 (from 1f4c740a, 17 November) converged at x2 = 7.177734375e-15 m^2/s, bracket [7.176208496e-15, 7.177734375e-15], 37 points, the half-step check passed; neither-01, picks-01/-02, dense-01 and ladder-01 ran the line at many D values. These conditions were written after; the judged run repeats the search fresh from the tag.
not_blind.field: A true pre-registration (D219): no 25 x 25 world has run past 16 s. Seen before this rule: BITSEY's whole 2D bisection in its saved log (bracket 1.886e-15 to 1.888e-15); sheet-01, a different world (9 x 9, a central 3 x 3 tumor, 2,000 s), whose threshold lay between 9.0e-16 and 1.8e-15; field-parse-01, a parse with no integration; and the cost probe field-cost-01: D = 1e-13 for 1.5 s and D = 0 for 16 s, where every tumor cell was still mesenchymal and every healthy cell epithelial (589 of 625), which cannot show a threshold; the smokes probes/smoke-registered-01 (a field point, D = 1e-13 for 0.25 s; a field search and a line search at 0.25 s and 2 s, each stopped at its upper end); and the pinned BITSEY field run's first five outcomes (D = 0 not normalized; 1e-13, 5e-14, 2.5e-14 and 1.25e-14 normalized), as in the historical log

compute_budget.measured: field-cost-01 on today's engine (main db54d0f5), one CPU: the field takes 0.16-0.19 s a step (with or without routes; 32- and 16-step windows, 1.3 GB), the line 3.4 ms a step; the first window's compile 72-77 s
compute_budget.line: as neither-02: about 37 points, 8 CPU-hours; the upper end's 1.28 million steps (72 minutes) are the critical path; on four light CPUs about 2-3 hours
compute_budget.field: a base-step point (1/8 s, 160,000 steps) takes 7-8.5 hours; the upper end (1/128 s, 2.56 million steps) 4.7-5.6 days; the search with its convergence check about 350-410 CPU-hours. It does not fit the light CPUs; the field runs when the lead assigns the compute, or after an amendment tagged before it runs
compute_budget.memory: the line 1.2 GB a worker, the field 1.3 GB a worker
